items.name: formdef
items.title: formdef setup
items.description: The wiring every formdef form needs: the TanStack contexts in one file, the registry that names your widgets in another.
items.docs: Fetch this first. It lands in lib/formdef/: context.ts holds the TanStack contexts, index.tsx the registry, so you import @/lib/formdef. Add an entry under widgets for every widget you fetch, then build forms with the createForm it exports.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: A formdef widget for string values, built on shadcn's Field and Input, with optional addons in an input group.
items.docs: Register it in lib/formdef: widgets: { text: TextField }.

items.name: textarea-field
items.title: Textarea field
items.description: A formdef widget for longer string values, built on shadcn's Field and Textarea, with optional addons in an input group.
items.docs: Register it in lib/formdef: widgets: { textarea: TextareaField }.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: A formdef widget for passwords, built on shadcn's Field and InputGroup, with a button that shows and hides the value.
items.docs: Register it in lib/formdef: widgets: { password: PasswordField }. Rename the button's labels with reveal: { show, hide }.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A formdef widget for optional number values, built on shadcn's Field and Input; an empty input is undefined.
items.docs: Register it in lib/formdef: widgets: { number: NumberField }. Its value is number | undefined, so the schema allows undefined. It is meant for counts and whole numbers; take a text field with inputMode: 'decimal' for amounts and decimals, which users type with a comma.
